title: Warmly Roasted Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring roasted lamb, stilton cheese, and agemono-deep-fry, perfect for a high-protein meal or hangover cure. This recipe is cooked on a robata-grill for a crispy exterior and a warm, juicy interior.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the robata-grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the lamb is cooking, heat about 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the oil is hot, add the crumbled stilton cheese and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the cheese from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the roasted lamb kebabs with the crispy stilton cheese, pita bread, and your choice of toppings.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
